It isn't stated whether line numbers start at 0 or 1. It also doesn't say how blank lines or other malformed lines are handled.

point: `remex search INDEX QUERY_FILE` prints the top-k nearest neighbours for each query vector as JSON Lines. It uses 4-bit precision by default, which is faster and less accurate than keeping floats, and it rescores candidates only when the index was built with `--keep-float`.
